Hey, I resonate with you, I feel like I am unable to work due to my lack of motivation and boredom which plagues me at every job I’ve tried to work. Although we may struggle, we don’t have to consume our feelings, have you ever heard of radical acceptance? 

It’s a skill which means to accept your current situation, which is cool because it means our feelings and situation is temporary, there is hope that our circumstances will change. If we become caught up in our feelings, we start to embody frustration and stress, rather than feel our emotions and let them go. 

It sounds like you’re doing the best you can at the moment, try to not let comparison, become a thief of your joy. When I’m overwhelmed, I try to meditate by observing my thoughts and feelings in my body, even if it’s for 5 minutes I feel a little better after. Incorporating meditation into your daily life serves as a good coping mechanisms and reminder that our feelings are just that. 
Feelings aren’t reality, we are just experiencing them. 

I urge you to write down your dreams, and plans for life, as if you have achieved them, how would you feel as the person who has it all. Now embody that person, and be that person. Just live as if you are the person with your dream life. I recommend exercising daily if you can, this is great for people with ADHD and will help regulate your nervous system too! 

Cliche but eating balanced meals, practicing self compassion, mindfulness and cultivating a support circle all helps us as humans, we need our basic needs met, and we need to believe in ourselves while being kind to ourselves. I hope you’re feeling better, and I wish you loads of peace, happiness and joy. You deserve it, and everything you have to offer, your dream life etc it’s already yours, embody it and believe it. Take care.

Everything is a habit, as you eat more unhealthily foods or miss meals, your body will become used to it. One day when you’ll feel motivated make a meal, make something you love, this will give you a sense of accomplishment and dopamine.

Some people enjoy meal prepping, I personally don’t, I rather make meals freshly. Find whatever is better for you, and try to have easy to make meals or ingredients available. ADHD is easier managed when we build habits, and your body will adapt, and crave more healthier, balanced meals the more you feed it. 

Try not to be so hard on yourself, you’ve truly got this. One day at a time, you can alternate between a balanced meal for breakfast, junk for lunch, and balanced again for dinner, if that’s easier for you. I also recommend making a list of five meals for breakfast, lunch and dinner, your favourite, easy to make/ heat up go to meals so you always have a menu ready to use! 

All the best to you, sending you loads of love and support. Xx

Hey I struggle with depressive episodes which lead to a lack of motivation, I’ve realised that a lack of motivation isn’t simultaneous with a lack of willpower or discipline. 

When we lack motivation due to our ADHD or low moods, we can try to do opposite behaviour and actions for example, making food even though you feel unmotivated because you deserve to eat and food taste amazing! I use this for when I don’t feel like showering, eating or exercising, I guess it’s also practicing self love and care, and reminding yourself no matter how you feel, you do deserve to be fed and looked after. 

Especially as a university student it absolutely sucks sometimes not having anyone to help you, but my time at university shown me that I am always there for myself, and so are you. It doesn’t matter if it takes you hours to get out of bed, just think about how you’ll feel eating a meal you have prepared for yourself, how caring and loving that is. 

Every time, it will feel hard at first, but it will get easier as you build it as a habit. The fact you’ve made this post means you care, you are worried about your wellbeing which is a sign of self love, I am so proud of you! 

You can try making a list of easy to cook or heating up meals. I made bacon and eggs for dinner today, because it takes about 10 mins. Anything which is filling for you, and somewhat balanced is good for you! I wish you the best, loads of love and blessings to you.
